info.title: timetracker
info.description: CLI for managing time entries in 7pace Timetracker.

commands.name: config
commands.description: Configure the CLI parameters for connecting to your Timetracker instance.

options.name: --url
options.description: Specify the URL for your Timetracker instance (e.g., https://<company>.timehub.7pace.com).

options.name: --token
options.description: Provide the Bearer Token required for authentication with your Timetracker instance.

options.name: --show
options.description: Display the current configuration, masking the bearer token.

options.name: --reset
options.description: Remove all local configuration and activity cache files.

options.name: --border
options.description: Table border style for list output: minimal (default), square, or markdown.

options.name: --help
options.description: Display this help screen.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information.

commands.name: activities
commands.description: Display a list of available activity types.

options.name: --sync
options.description: Synchronize activity types with the server before displaying the list.

options.name: --help
options.description: Display this help screen.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information.

commands.name: add
commands.description: Add a new activity directly to the server.

options.name: --date
options.description: Date for the activity: YYYY/MM/DD (e.g., 2025/12/31), 'today' or 'yesterday'. Defaults to today. [default: today]

options.name: --work-item
options.description: Specify the Work Item ID associated with the activity.

options.name: --length
options.description: Specify the duration of the activity in hours (e.g., 0.5 for half an hour).

options.name: --type
options.description: Specify the type of activity. Use the 'activities' command to list available types.

options.name: --comment
options.description: Provide a comment for the activity.

options.name: --hour
options.description: Specify the start time of the activity in the format HH:MM (e.g., 09:00 or 21:00) [default: 09:00]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Preview the entry that would be submitted without sending it to the server.

options.name: --help
options.description: Display this help screen.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List time entries for a given period.

options.name: --from
options.description: Start date in the format YYYY/MM/DD, 'today' or 'yesterday'. Defaults to today.

options.name: --to
options.description: End date in the format YYYY/MM/DD, 'today' or 'yesterday'. Defaults to today.

options.name: --period
options.description: Show entries for a specific month in the format YYYY/MM (e.g., 2026/06). Cannot be used with --from, --to or week/month shortcuts.

options.name: --month
options.description: Show entries for the current month. Cannot be used with --from, --to, --period or other shortcuts.

options.name: --last-month
options.description: Show entries for the previous month. Cannot be used with --from, --to, --period or other shortcuts.

options.name: --work-item
options.description: Filter entries by Work Item ID.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output format. Use 'json' to export entries in batch-upload format.

options.name: --ids
options.description: Show entry IDs instead of comments. Useful for identifying entries to delete.

options.name: --today
options.description: Show entries for today. Cannot be used with --from, --to, --week, --yesterday, --last-week or --period.

options.name: --yesterday
options.description: Show entries for yesterday. Cannot be used with --from, --to, --today, --week, --last-week or --period.

options.name: --week
options.description: Show entries for the current week (Monday to Sunday). Cannot be used with --from, --to or --period.

options.name: --last-week
options.description: Show entries for the previous week (Monday to Sunday). Cannot be used with --from, --to or --period.

options.name: --help
options.description: Display this help screen.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information.

commands.name: summary
commands.description: Show a daily summary of logged hours for a given period.

options.name: --from
options.description: Start date in the format YYYY/MM/DD, 'today' or 'yesterday'. Defaults to today.

options.name: --to
options.description: End date in the format YYYY/MM/DD, 'today' or 'yesterday'. Defaults to today.

options.name: --period
options.description: Summarize a specific month in the format YYYY/MM (e.g., 2026/06). Cannot be used with --from, --to or week/month shortcuts.

options.name: --month
options.description: Summarize the current month. Cannot be used with --from, --to, --period or other shortcuts.

options.name: --last-month
options.description: Summarize the previous month. Cannot be used with --from, --to, --period or other shortcuts.

options.name: --today
options.description: Summarize today. Cannot be used with --from, --to or other shortcuts.

options.name: --yesterday
options.description: Summarize yesterday. Cannot be used with --from, --to or other shortcuts.

options.name: --week
options.description: Summarize the current week (Monday to Sunday). Cannot be used with --from, --to or --period.

options.name: --last-week
options.description: Summarize the previous week (Monday to Sunday). Cannot be used with --from, --to or --period.

options.name: --work-item
options.description: Filter entries by Work Item ID.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output format: 'json' or 'csv'. Defaults to a table.

options.description: Display this help screen.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information.

commands.name: delete
commands.description: Delete one or more time entries by ID.

options.name: --id
options.description: ID(s) of the time entries to delete. Repeat the flag or separate with commas: -i id1 -i id2 or -i id1,id2.

options.name: --force
options.description: Skip the confirmation prompt before deleting.

options.name: --help
options.description: Display this help screen.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information.

options.name: --id
options.description: ID of the time entry to update.

options.name: --date
options.description: New date in the format YYYY/MM/DD, 'today' or 'yesterday'.

options.name: --work-item
options.description: New Work Item ID.

options.name: --length
options.description: New duration in hours (e.g., 0.5 for half an hour).

options.name: --type
options.description: New activity type. Use the 'activities' command to list available types.

options.name: --comment
options.description: New comment.

options.name: --hour
options.description: New start time in the format HH:MM (e.g., 09:00).

options.description: Display this help screen.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information.

commands.name: copy
commands.description: Duplicate an existing time entry to a target date (defaults to today).

options.name: --date
options.description: Target date in the format YYYY/MM/DD, 'today' or 'yesterday'. Defaults to today.

options.name: --dry-run
